title: Close or auto-close inMemoryDb() in profiles _buildApp test helpers — 3 files leak native Drift handles whenever db: is omitted

evidence.quote:
/// Callers MUST `await db.close()` in `tearDown` to free the native
/// resources.
/// Callers MUST `await db.close()` in `tearDown` to free the native

why: drift_memory.dart's own contract says callers MUST close inMemoryDb(). In these 3 files, _buildApp (and _buildAppLoading/_buildAppError, which have no db: parameter at all) construct one via `db ?? inMemoryDb()` whenever the optional db: is omitted, and the large majority of testWidgets in parent_settings_screen_l1_test.dart and parent_track_management_screen_l1_test.dart (~30 of ~40 across the two files) do omit it, so each test run leaks a native sqlite3 in-memory connection nothing ever closes — the caller has no reference to the db, so it can't be closed even in a teardown. At the scale of this test suite (dozens of files following the same pattern), this is a plausible contributor to CI slowness or file-descriptor/memory pressure.
recommendation: Make db a required parameter (as ts3_parent_track_archive_test.dart already does correctly, forcing every call site to own+close it), or have _buildApp itself call addTearDown(() => resolvedDb.close()) so omitting db: is automatically safe.
acceptance_criteria: Every _buildApp/_buildAppLoading/_buildAppError variant in these 3 files either requires db: or internally registers addTearDown to close the database it created.
mergedFrom: Register onDispose when overriding userDatabaseProvider with inMemoryDb() in tracks_studydays_and_content_hierarchy_l1_test.dart
Close every inMemoryDb() Drift database opened by tracks/setup and track_order widget tests
Close every inMemoryDb() opened in the progress test suite via addTearDown per drift_memory.dart's documented contract
